newsitem.title: USA: Wyle CEO Ozorkiewicz to leave.
newsitem.headline: Wyle CEO Ozorkiewicz to leave.

text.p: Wyle Electronics said its board has formed a special committee to select a new chief executive officer to succeed Ralph Ozorkiewicz, who plans to relinquish his role near-term due to health reasons.
Ozorkiewicz was diagnosed with multiple sclerosis a number of years ago and only recently has experienced symptoms that could adversely affect the performance of his duties, it said.

The special committee, consisting of five directors, is headed by Charles Clough, chairman of the board, who was also Wyle's chief executive officer until 1995. The board also approved a one-year extension of Clough's agreement under which he will now serve as chairman through May 1999.
